13 章 · 自动导览约 180 秒 · 可随时暂停探索: 13 chapters · 180-second auto tour · Pause to explore
让技术进入工作与生活，让更多人能够参与、能够使用、能够受益。: Bring technology into everyday life and work so more people can participate, use it and benefit.
尊重当地语言、资源条件与实践经验，与当地伙伴共同建设适宜的方案。: Respect local languages, resources and experience. Build suitable solutions with local partners.
学习、判断、实践与协作，把可获得的技术转化为有用的成果。: Learning, judgment, practice and collaboration turn accessible technology into useful outcomes.
通过复用、推广和本地化，让数字公共品成为广泛可及的实际帮助。: Reuse, adaptation and localization turn digital public goods into widely accessible benefits.
完善指标、指数与基准探索，让评价有可解释的参照。: Develop indicators, indices and benchmarks that provide an interpretable basis for evaluation.
通过平台连接数据、方法与实践，逐步贯通评价工作。: Connect data, methods and practice through a platform, progressively integrating evaluation.
服务贡献识别、协作分析和效果检验，让发现的问题反馈到下一轮采集。: Identify contributions, analyze collaboration and assess outcomes. Feed findings back into data collection.
让参与者获得反馈、认可与实践机会，看见自身成长。: Give participants feedback, recognition and practical opportunities so they can see their growth.
以合理回馈与激励吸引更多人参与，支持贡献者持续成长。: Use appropriate recognition and incentives to attract participation and support continued growth.
通过学习、创造与维护，提高数字公共品的质量与可用性。: Improve the quality and usability of digital public goods through learning, creation and maintenance.
让更多人获得切实帮助，将新的贡献与成效纳入下一轮评价。: Deliver practical benefits to more people and include new contributions and outcomes in the next evaluation.
结合 OpenRank 与多维实践证据，完善贡献核算、人才识别和资源匹配。: Combine OpenRank with multiple forms of practical evidence to improve contribution assessment, talent identification and resource matching.
围绕人才连接、生态洞察与公共价值形成合作回馈，并明确适用条件。: Offer partnership value through talent connections, ecosystem insights and public benefit, with clear conditions.
以具体情境与实践结果检验投入成效，为下一轮持续支持提供依据。: Evaluate investment in context and through practical outcomes to inform continued support.
让开发者和组织复用成果，回应真实工作需要。: Help developers and organizations reuse shared work to address real needs.
让知识与工具在分享、反馈和维护中持续改善。: Improve knowledge and tools through sharing, feedback and ongoing maintenance.
与当地伙伴共同回应语言、文化和公共服务需求。: Work with local partners to address language, cultural and public-service needs.
区分计划、试点和已完成事项，记录贡献、投入与受益变化。: Distinguish plans, pilots and completed work. Record contributions, resources and changes in benefits.
结合数据、使用者反馈与专业判断，公开问题并支持纠错。: Combine data, user feedback and expert judgment. Disclose problems and support correction.
让新证据、新贡献和新成效回到三个飞轮，让经验回到行动。: Feed new evidence, contributions and outcomes back into the three flywheels, bringing experience into action.
